description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to cancel a lobby that has not started. Its invitation stops working and nobody can play it. A game in progress is stopped in Playloop instead. Reuse requestId for identical retries.

requestId.description: Stable UUID for this intent. Reuse it with identical arguments after a lost response; use a new UUID for a different action.

runId.description: The game ID (runId) returned by create_quiz, list_quizzes or get_quiz.

name: cancel_lobby
title: Cancel a lobby
